user.title: Add Ctronics camera
user.description: Enter the address and login of the camera. The same login is used in the Ctronics Pro app and in the camera's web interface.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: Fixed IP address of the camera, ideally reserved in your router.
data_description.port: Port of the camera's web interface, normally 80.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {name} was rejected. Enter the current username and password.

reconfigure.title: Change camera connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address or login of this camera.

error.cannot_connect: The camera could not be reached. Check the IP address and port.
error.unknown_device: The device did not report a MAC address and does not look like a supported camera.
error.wrong_device: This is a different camera than the one that was set up.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up. Its address was updated.

data.ptz_step_ms: Step duration of the direction buttons

data_description.ptz_step_ms: How long the camera moves when a direction button is pressed.
data_description.presets: One position per line as number and name, for example "1: Swing". Numbers go from 1 to 64. The positions themselves are stored in the camera. If you list any, a preset selector appears.

error.invalid_presets: Use one line per position in the form "number: name" with a number from 1 to 64.

ptz_move.name: Move camera
ptz_move.description: Moves the camera briefly in one direction and stops it again.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Speed from 1 to 8. Default is the PTZ speed setting.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to move, in seconds. Default is the step duration from the options.

ptz_goto_preset.name: Go to preset
ptz_goto_preset.description: Moves the camera to a stored position.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Number of the stored position, 1 to 64.

ptz_save_preset.name: Save preset
ptz_save_preset.description: Stores the current position of the camera. An existing position with the same number is overwritten.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Number to store the position under, 1 to 64.

ptz_delete_preset.name: Delete preset
ptz_delete_preset.description: Deletes a stored position from the camera.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Number of the position to delete, 1 to 64.
